name: Hotel Randers, Torvegade
description: Founded 1856, Denmark's oldest provincial hotel. Art Deco dining room that won a prize at the 1934 Copenhagen exhibition. Autumn 1943: half German officers, half the kind of Randers bourgeoisie who still come. Ole and Inger play at the far end.
notes: German use of the hotel is our invention. Not documented as German-used in our sources.
